notes.title: Content Update 5
notes.notes:
New Heroes:
Professor Moriarty, Perseus, Ninja minion
New Rivals campaign with 10 chapters.
New Scenario Mode that unlocks bonus skins.
Fight Medusa in an Epic battle!

notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.notes: We've added new casual and normal difficulty options, holiday character skins, artifacts that enable new powerful abilities, and a new Holiday themed campaign. The new campaign features Santa, Mrs. Claus, Elfs, and Krampus!  There are 9 character skins and 15 artifacts to find in the campaign.

notes.title: Holiday Content Update Coming Soon
notes.notes: We're busy working on the December content update. We'll be introducing casual and normal difficulty options, holiday character skins, artifacts that enable new powerful abilities, and a new Holiday themed campaign. The new campaign will feature Santa, Mrs. Claus, and Krumpus! In addition there will be a new elf minion. Stay tuned for the new release in the coming weeks.

notes.title: Content Update #2
notes.notes: Enjoy this spooky update to Heroes of Yore. Unlock new heroes such as Frankenstein, a ghost, Miss Fury, and Moon Girl. Fight the headless horseman in an epic battle. Enjoy a full new haunted campaign!

notes.title: Heroes of Yore Content Update #1
notes.notes: Heroes of Yore just launched into Early Access, and we are already full-steam ahead on development of a new campaign set in ancient Egypt. New unlockable characters will include Cleopatra, Napoléon, and a Mummy minion. Enjoy ten new chapters as you explore the secrets of Ancient Egypt and even do battle with a well-known god on your conquest.
